title: Pointwise pseudo-coherent localization on an affine open
statement: Let X be affine [def-pc-scheme], U an open, and A=Gamma(X,O_X). Fix the derived categories [def-pc-derived-category] on X, on U and on every localized open site of U, with the last two in the same morphism universe, and module derived categories over each A_f in an independent universe. Let T from A-modules to structure-sheaf modules on X preserve zero morphisms and be naturally isomorphic to tilde followed by restriction along X.isoSpec.hom. Let M be an A-module complex. Suppose the derived restriction to U of Q(T M) is pseudo-coherent [def-pur-pseudo-coherent-complex]. For each x in U there is f in A with x in D(f), D(f) contained in U, and Q(M_f) pseudo-coherent [def-pc-ring-pseudo-coherent-complex]. No compactness of U or finite family is asserted.

proof.text: Apply the definition of pseudo-coherence at the point x of U. Obtain a neighbourhood V in U, a bounded-above complex P of finite free modules on its localized site, and an isomorphism from the derived restriction of Q(T M) to Q(P). Map V into X using the open immersion of U. Its image W is open, contained in U, and contains x.

proof.text: Transport X to Spec(A) by X.isoSpec. The principal-open basis yields a in A with x in D(a) contained in W. Transport P to the localized site of the image of W in Spec(A). Use the exact equivalences on module sheaves induced by the scheme isomorphism and the open scheme/localized site equivalences. These preserve zero objects and carry free modules to free modules of the same rank via preservation of coproducts and the unit-sheaf comparison. Localize these equivalences; the composition and localization factorization comparisons transport the local-model isomorphism. The natural isomorphism hT identifies the transported termwise T-complex with the tilde complex of M. Auxiliary derived categories on Spec(A) and its open sites may be the standard ones; localization equivalences compare them with the supplied categories, so no equality of morphism universes is needed.

proof.text: Apply affine_pseudoCoherent_principal_model to this neighbourhood, the chosen principal open D(a), the transported P and its bound, finite ranks and model isomorphism. It makes Q(M_a) pseudo-coherent. Return a, its membership at x, containment in U and this property. For empty U there is no point; for empty principal opens the principal-model theorem includes the zero ring.

lean.statement:
theorem affine_open_pseudoCoherent_localization_point
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsAffine X] (U : X.Opens)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ V : U.toScheme.Opens, HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace).over V))]
    [∀ f : X.presheaf.obj (.op ⊤), HasDerivedCategory.{wL}
      (ModuleCat.{u} (Localization.Away f))]
    (T : ModuleCat.{u} (X.presheaf.obj (.op ⊤)) ⥤
      SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) [T.PreservesZeroMorphisms]
    (hT : Nonempty (T ≅ tilde.functor (X.presheaf.obj (.op ⊤)) ⋙
      Modules.restrictFunctor X.isoSpec.hom))
    (M : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} (X.presheaf.obj (.op ⊤))) ℤ)
    (hM : IsPseudoCoherent U.toScheme
      (((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) U) ⋙
        Equivalence.functor
          (C := SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U))
          (D := SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace))
          (Modules.overEquiv U)).mapDerivedCategory.obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj
        ((T.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj M))))
    (x : X) (hx : x ∈ U) :
    ∃ f : X.presheaf.obj (.op ⊤), x ∈ X.basicOpen f ∧ X.basicOpen f ≤ U ∧
      DerivedCategory.IsPseudoCoherent
        (DerivedCategory.Q.obj ((Functor.mapHomologicalComplex
          (ModuleCat.extendScalars
            (algebraMap (X.presheaf.obj (.op ⊤)) (Localization.Away f)))
          (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj M))
